question_en: Which statements are true? 1) the EMF is the work of non-electrostatic forces in moving a unit positive charge inside the source; 2) in an open circuit the terminal voltage equals the EMF; 3) with a current, the terminal voltage exceeds the EMF; 4) the EMF is measured in newtons.
question_uz: Qaysi fikrlar to'g'ri? 1) EYK — chetki kuchlarning birlik musbat zaryadni manba ichida ko'chirish ishi; 2) zanjir ochiq bo'lsa, qisqichlardagi kuchlanish EYK ga teng; 3) tok o'tganda qisqichlardagi kuchlanish EYK dan katta; 4) EYK nyutonlarda o'lchanadi.
question_ru: Какие утверждения верны? 1) ЭДС — работа сторонних сил по перемещению единичного положительного заряда внутри источника; 2) при разомкнутой цепи напряжение на зажимах равно ЭДС; 3) когда идёт ток, напряжение на зажимах больше ЭДС; 4) ЭДС измеряется в ньютонах.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. ℰ = A*/q — birlik zaryadga beriladigan energiya, birligi volt. I = 0 da U = ℰ, tok o'tganda U = ℰ − Ir < ℰ.
Asos: ℰ = A*/q, U = ℰ − Ir.

en: 1 — definition of EMF; 4 — its unit is volt: $$\mathcal{E}=\frac{A^*}{q},\qquad \mathrm{V}=\mathrm{J/C}$$
2 is true, 3 is false: $$I=0:\ U=\mathcal{E};\qquad I>0:\ U=\mathcal{E}-Ir<\mathcal{E}$$

distractors.A: tok o'tganda kuchlanish ortadi deb olingan
distractors.C: EYK kuch deb, nyutonda o'lchanadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: считали, что при токе напряжение растёт
distractors_ru.C: ЭДС принята за силу в ньютонах

distractors_en.A: the voltage was assumed to grow with current
distractors_en.C: the EMF was taken as a force in newtons
distractors_en.D: statement 3 was also taken as true

question_en: A resistor of resistance $5.6\ \Omega$ is connected to a source with EMF $12\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $0.4\ \Omega$. Find the current in the circuit ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_uz: EYK si $12\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $0.4\ \Omega$ bo'lgan manbaga $5.6\ \Omega$ qarshilikli rezistor ulangan. Zanjirdagi tok kuchini toping ($\mathrm{A}$).
question_ru: К источнику с ЭДС $12\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $0.4\ \Omega$ подключён резистор сопротивлением $5.6\ \Omega$. Найдите силу тока в цепи ($\mathrm{A}$).
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Zanjirning to'liq qarshiligi R + r = 5,6 + 0,4 = 6 Ω, I = ℰ/(R + r) = 12/6 = 2 A.
Asos: to'liq zanjir uchun Om qonuni I = ℰ/(R + r).

en: Ohm's law for a complete circuit: $$I=\frac{\mathcal{E}}{R+r}=\frac{12}{5.6+0.4}=2\ \mathrm{A}$$

rules.en: Ohm's law for a complete circuit: $I=\frac{\mathcal{E}}{R+r}$

question_en: A current of $0.6\ \mathrm{A}$ is drawn from a battery with EMF $4.5\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $1.5\ \Omega$. What is the terminal voltage of the battery in volts?
question_uz: EYK si $4.5\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $1.5\ \Omega$ bo'lgan batareyadan $0.6\ \mathrm{A}$ tok olinmoqda. Batareya qisqichlaridagi kuchlanish necha volt?
question_ru: От батареи с ЭДС $4.5\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $1.5\ \Omega$ берут ток $0.6\ \mathrm{A}$. Каково напряжение на зажимах батареи в вольтах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Ichki tushuv Ir = 0,6·1,5 = 0,9 V, qisqichlarda U = ℰ − Ir = 4,5 − 0,9 = 3,6 V.
Asos: U = ℰ − Ir.

distractors.D: kuchlanish EYK ga teng deb olingan

distractors_en.B: the internal drop was added (as when charging)
distractors_en.C: only the internal drop Ir was found
distractors_en.D: the voltage was taken equal to the EMF

question_en: When a resistance of $4\ \Omega$ is connected to a source with EMF $9\ \mathrm{V}$, a current of $2\ \mathrm{A}$ flows in the circuit. What is the short-circuit current of the source in amperes?
question_uz: EYK si $9\ \mathrm{V}$ bo'lgan manbaga $4\ \Omega$ qarshilik ulanganda zanjirda $2\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tadi. Manbaning qisqa tutashuv toki necha amper?
question_ru: Когда к источнику с ЭДС $9\ \mathrm{V}$ подключают сопротивление $4\ \Omega$, в цепи идёт ток $2\ \mathrm{A}$. Каков ток короткого замыкания источника в амперах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. R + r = ℰ/I = 4,5 Ω, demak r = 0,5 Ω; qisqa tutashuvda I(max) = ℰ/r = 9/0,5 = 18 A.
Asos: I = ℰ/(R + r), I(max) = ℰ/r.

rules.en: Ohm's law for a complete circuit: $I=\frac{\mathcal{E}}{R+r}$

distractors.B: ichki qarshilik R/I = 2 Ω deb olingan
distractors.E: ichki tushuv tok kvadratiga bo'lingan: r = 1/4 Ω

distractors_ru.B: внутреннее сопротивление взято как R/I = 2 Ω
distractors_ru.C: за ответ принят ток в цепи
distractors_ru.E: внутреннее падение делили на квадрат тока: r = 1/4 Ω

distractors_en.B: the internal resistance was taken as R/I = 2 Ω
distractors_en.C: the current in the circuit was taken as the answer
distractors_en.E: the internal drop was divided by the current squared: r = 1/4 Ω

question_en: The figure shows the graph of the terminal voltage of a source versus the current. What will the current in amperes be if a resistor of resistance $4\ \Omega$ is connected to this source?
question_uz: Rasmda manba qisqichlaridagi kuchlanishning tok kuchiga bog'liqlik grafigi berilgan. Shu manbaga $4\ \Omega$ qarshilikli rezistor ulansa, zanjirdagi tok kuchi necha amper bo'ladi?
question_ru: На рисунке дан график зависимости напряжения на зажимах источника от силы тока. Какой будет сила тока в амперах, если к этому источнику подключить резистор сопротивлением $4\ \Omega$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Grafikdan ℰ = 9 V (I = 0), I(max) = 4,5 A (U = 0), r = ℰ/I(max) = 2 Ω. I = ℰ/(R + r) = 9/6 = 1,5 A.
Asos: U = ℰ − Ir.

uz: Grafikdan EYK va ichki qarshilik: $$\mathcal{E}=9\ \mathrm{V},\qquad r=\frac{9}{4.5}=2\ \Omega$$
ru: ЭДС и внутреннее сопротивление по графику: $$\mathcal{E}=9\ \mathrm{V},\qquad r=\frac{9}{4.5}=2\ \Omega$$
en: EMF and internal resistance from the graph: $$\mathcal{E}=9\ \mathrm{V},\qquad r=\frac{9}{4.5}=2\ \Omega$$

distractors.B: qisqa tutashuv toki javob deb olingan
distractors.C: ichki qarshilik teskari olingan: r = 0,5 Ω
distractors.D: EYK o'rniga qisqa tutashuv toki qo'yilgan

distractors_ru.B: за ответ принят ток короткого замыкания
distractors_ru.D: вместо ЭДС подставлен ток короткого замыкания

distractors_en.B: the short-circuit current was taken as the answer
distractors_en.C: the internal resistance was inverted: r = 0.5 Ω
distractors_en.D: the short-circuit current was used instead of the EMF

question_en: What is the largest power ($\mathrm{W}$) that a source with EMF $18\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $3\ \Omega$ can deliver to the external circuit?
question_uz: EYK si $18\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $3\ \Omega$ bo'lgan manba tashqi zanjirda eng ko'pi bilan qancha quvvat ($\mathrm{W}$) bera oladi?
question_ru: Какую наибольшую мощность ($\mathrm{W}$) может отдать во внешнюю цепь источник с ЭДС $18\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $3\ \Omega$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Foydali quvvat R = r = 3 Ω da eng katta: P(max) = ℰ²/(4r) = 324/12 = 27 W, FIK 50 foiz.
Asos: R = r da P(max) = ℰ²/(4r).

distractors_ru.A: полная мощность при коротком замыкании: ε²/r

distractors_en.A: the total power at short circuit: ε²/r
distractors_en.C: 2r was used in the denominator instead of 4r

question_en: A heater of resistance $4\ \Omega$ is connected to a source with EMF $10\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $1\ \Omega$. What is the efficiency of the source in percent?
question_uz: EYK si $10\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $1\ \Omega$ bo'lgan manbaga $4\ \Omega$ qarshilikli isitkich ulangan. Manbaning FIK necha foiz?
question_ru: К источнику с ЭДС $10\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $1\ \Omega$ подключён нагреватель сопротивлением $4\ \Omega$. Каков КПД источника в процентах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. η = R/(R + r) = 4/5 = 0,8, ya'ni 80 foiz. EYK qiymati javobga ta'sir qilmaydi.
Asos: η = U/ℰ = R/(R + r).

distractors_en.B: the fraction lost was found: r/(R + r)
distractors_en.D: the efficiency was taken as 1 − r/R

question_en: $5$ cells, each with EMF $1.2\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $0.4\ \Omega$, are connected in series to a resistance of $4\ \Omega$. What is the current in the circuit in amperes?
question_uz: Har birining EYK si $1.2\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $0.4\ \Omega$ bo'lgan $5$ ta element ketma-ket ulanib, $4\ \Omega$ qarshilikka ulangan. Zanjirdagi tok kuchi necha amper?
question_ru: $5$ элементов, каждый с ЭДС $1.2\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $0.4\ \Omega$, соединены последовательно и подключены к сопротивлению $4\ \Omega$. Какова сила тока в цепи в амперах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Ketma-ket: ℰ = 5·1,2 = 6 V, r = 5·0,4 = 2 Ω; I = 6/(4 + 2) = 1 A.
Asos: ℰ = nℰ₀, r = nr₀.

distractors.B: faqat bitta elementning ichki qarshiligi olingan
distractors.E: bitta element qarshiligi olinib, R tashlangan: 6/0,4

distractors_ru.E: взято сопротивление одного элемента, R отброшено: 6/0,4

distractors_en.B: the internal resistance of only one cell was used
distractors_en.D: the current of a single cell was found
distractors_en.E: one cell's resistance was used and R dropped: 6/0.4

question_en: $4$ identical cells, each with EMF $6\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $2\ \Omega$, are connected in parallel to a resistance of $2.5\ \Omega$. What is the current in the external circuit in amperes?
question_uz: Har birining EYK si $6\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $2\ \Omega$ bo'lgan $4$ ta bir xil element parallel ulanib, $2.5\ \Omega$ qarshilikka ulangan. Tashqi zanjirdagi tok kuchi necha amper?
question_ru: $4$ одинаковых элемента, каждый с ЭДС $6\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $2\ \Omega$, соединены параллельно и подключены к сопротивлению $2.5\ \Omega$. Какова сила тока во внешней цепи в амперах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Parallel: ℰ = 6 V, r = 2/4 = 0,5 Ω; I = 6/(2,5 + 0,5) = 2 A.
Asos: ℰ = ℰ₀, r = r₀/n.

distractors_en.B: the cells were taken as connected in series
distractors_en.E: the current through one cell was found

question_en: Two sources with EMFs $12\ \mathrm{V}$ and $8\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistances of $1\ \Omega$ each are connected in series with like terminals together and connected to a $2\ \Omega$ resistor. What is the current in amperes?
question_uz: EYK lari $12\ \mathrm{V}$ va $8\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiliklari $1\ \Omega$ dan bo'lgan ikki manba bir xil nomli qutblari bilan ketma-ket ulanib, $2\ \Omega$ rezistorga ulangan. Tok kuchi necha amper?
question_ru: Два источника с ЭДС $12\ \mathrm{V}$ и $8\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренними сопротивлениями по $1\ \Omega$ соединены последовательно одноимёнными полюсами и подключены к резистору $2\ \Omega$. Какова сила тока в амперах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Qarama-qarshi ulashda ℰ = 12 − 8 = 4 V, ichki qarshiliklar qo'shiladi: r = 2 Ω. I = 4/(2 + 2) = 1 A.
Asos: ℰ = |ℰ₁ − ℰ₂|, r = r₁ + r₂.

distractors_en.C: only one internal resistance was used
distractors_en.D: the EMFs were added, without the internal resistances

question_en: When a $2\ \Omega$ resistor is connected to a source, the current is $3\ \mathrm{A}$; when a $5\ \Omega$ resistor is connected, it is $1.5\ \mathrm{A}$. What is the EMF of the source in volts?
question_uz: Manbaga $2\ \Omega$ rezistor ulanganda $3\ \mathrm{A}$, $5\ \Omega$ rezistor ulanganda $1.5\ \mathrm{A}$ tok o'tadi. Manbaning EYK si necha volt?
question_ru: При подключении к источнику резистора $2\ \Omega$ идёт ток $3\ \mathrm{A}$, при подключении резистора $5\ \Omega$ — ток $1.5\ \mathrm{A}$. Какова ЭДС источника в вольтах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. 3(2 + r) = 1,5(5 + r) dan 1,5r = 1,5, r = 1 Ω; ℰ = 3·(2 + 1) = 9 V.
Asos: ℰ = I(R + r) ikki holat uchun.

uz: Ikki holat uchun Om qonuni: $$3(2+r)=1.5(5+r)\quad\Rightarrow\quad r=1\ \Omega$$
ru: Закон Ома для двух случаев: $$3(2+r)=1.5(5+r)\quad\Rightarrow\quad r=1\ \Omega$$
en: Ohm's law for the two cases: $$3(2+r)=1.5(5+r)\quad\Rightarrow\quad r=1\ \Omega$$

rules.en: Ohm's law for a complete circuit: $I=\frac{\mathcal{E}}{R+r}$

distractors.C: ikkinchi holatda ichki qarshilik tashlab yuborilgan
distractors.D: r = (R₂ − R₁)/(I₁ − I₂) = 2 Ω deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: во втором случае отброшено внутреннее сопротивление

distractors_en.C: the internal resistance was dropped in the second case
distractors_en.D: r = (R₂ − R₁)/(I₁ − I₂) = 2 Ω was used
distractors_en.E: only the internal drop I₁r was found

question_en: When resistors of $2\ \Omega$ and $32\ \Omega$ are connected to a source in turn, the same power is released in them. What is the internal resistance of the source in ohms?
question_uz: Manbaga navbat bilan $2\ \Omega$ va $32\ \Omega$ rezistorlar ulanganda ularda bir xil quvvat ajraladi. Manbaning ichki qarshiligi necha om?
question_ru: При поочерёдном подключении к источнику резисторов $2\ \Omega$ и $32\ \Omega$ в них выделяется одинаковая мощность. Каково внутреннее сопротивление источника в омах?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Foydali quvvatlar teng bo'lsa, R₁R₂ = r²: r = √(2·32) = 8 Ω.
Asos: teng quvvat sharti R₁R₂ = r².

distractors_en.B: the difference of the resistances was taken
distractors_en.D: the square root was not taken: r² = 64
distractors_en.E: half of the difference was taken

question_en: The resistance of a rheostat connected to a source was increased. Which statements are always true? 1) the current in the circuit decreases; 2) the terminal voltage increases; 3) the efficiency of the source increases; 4) the power in the rheostat increases.
question_uz: Manbaga ulangan reostatning qarshiligi oshirildi. Qaysi fikrlar doimo to'g'ri? 1) zanjirdagi tok kamayadi; 2) qisqichlardagi kuchlanish ortadi; 3) manbaning FIK ortadi; 4) reostatdagi quvvat ortadi.
question_ru: Сопротивление реостата, подключённого к источнику, увеличили. Какие утверждения всегда верны? 1) ток в цепи уменьшается; 2) напряжение на зажимах растёт; 3) КПД источника растёт; 4) мощность в реостате растёт.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. I = ℰ/(R + r) kamayadi, U = ℰ − Ir va η = R/(R + r) ortadi. Quvvat R = r gacha ortadi, keyin kamayadi — 4 doimo emas.
Asos: P(max) R = r da.

en: The current decreases, the voltage grows: $$I=\frac{\mathcal{E}}{R+r}\downarrow,\qquad U=\mathcal{E}-Ir\uparrow$$
The power is largest at $R=r$: $$R>r:\quad P_R\downarrow$$

distractors.C: tok kamayishi tushib qolgan, quvvat ortadi deb olingan

distractors_ru.C: пропущено уменьшение тока, мощность сочтена растущей

distractors_en.B: the power was assumed to always grow
distractors_en.C: the decrease of the current was left out, the power assumed to grow
distractors_en.E: the change of the voltage was left out

question_en: A battery with EMF $6\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $0.5\ \Omega$ is being charged with a current of $2\ \mathrm{A}$. How many volts does a voltmeter connected to the terminals of the battery show?
question_uz: EYK si $6\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $0.5\ \Omega$ bo'lgan akkumulyator $2\ \mathrm{A}$ tok bilan zaryadlanmoqda. Akkumulyator qisqichlariga ulangan voltmetr necha voltni ko'rsatadi?
question_ru: Аккумулятор с ЭДС $6\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $0.5\ \Omega$ заряжается током $2\ \mathrm{A}$. Сколько вольт показывает вольтметр, подключённый к зажимам аккумулятора?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Zaryadlashda tok EYK ga qarshi o'tadi: U = ℰ + Ir = 6 + 2·0,5 = 7 V.
Asos: zaryadlashda U = ℰ + Ir.

distractors.A: razryad formulasi U = ε − Ir ishlatilgan
distractors.B: kuchlanish EYK ga teng deb olingan

distractors_ru.A: использована формула разрядки U = ε − Ir

distractors_en.A: the discharge formula U = ε − Ir was used
distractors_en.B: the voltage was taken equal to the EMF
distractors_en.C: only the internal drop was found
distractors_en.E: the internal drop was added twice

question_en: There are $18$ cells, each with EMF $1.5\ \mathrm{V}$ and internal resistance $1\ \Omega$. What is the largest current in amperes that can be obtained through a $2\ \Omega$ resistor by grouping the cells?
question_uz: Har birining EYK si $1.5\ \mathrm{V}$, ichki qarshiligi $1\ \Omega$ bo'lgan $18$ ta element bor. Ularni guruhlab, $2\ \Omega$ rezistordan olish mumkin bo'lgan eng katta tok necha amper?
question_ru: Имеется $18$ элементов, каждый с ЭДС $1.5\ \mathrm{V}$ и внутренним сопротивлением $1\ \Omega$. Какой наибольший ток в амперах можно получить через резистор $2\ \Omega$, группируя элементы?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Eng katta tok nr₀/m = R da: n²/18 = 2, n = 6, m = 3. ℰ = 9 V, r = 2 Ω, I = 9/4 = 2,25 A.
Asos: aralash ulash, r = R.

uz: Eng katta tok sharti: $$\frac{nr_0}{m}=R,\quad nm=18\quad\Rightarrow\quad n=6,\ m=3$$
ru: Условие наибольшего тока: $$\frac{nr_0}{m}=R,\quad nm=18\quad\Rightarrow\quad n=6,\ m=3$$
en: Condition for the largest current: $$\frac{nr_0}{m}=R,\quad nm=18\quad\Rightarrow\quad n=6,\ m=3$$

distractors_en.B: the grouping n = 9, m = 2 was taken
distractors_en.C: all in series, without internal resistance
distractors_en.D: the grouping n = 3, m = 6 was taken
